title: How to Name Your Bearded Dragon — Complete Guide 🦎
description: Learn how to choose the perfect name for your bearded dragon. Tips, tricks, and 100+ ideas.

faq.q: What are the most popular bearded dragon names?
faq.a: Popular names include classics like Max, Bella, and Charlie, plus species-specific favorites.

faq.q: How do I choose the right name for my bearded dragon?
faq.a: Consider your bearded dragon's personality, appearance, and your preferences. Pick a name that is easy to say and that you will love.

faq.q: Should I pick a short or long name?
faq.a: Short names of 1-2 syllables are easier for animals to recognize. Use a longer formal name with a shorter nickname if you prefer.
